about: The bytes ONE typed session slot takes in each image, as the compiler lays it out for the target, read from the size of the WZ_SESSION_SLOT_BYTES probe symbol (scripts/lib/session_slot_bytes.py; build the image with the cargo feature slot-bytes-probe). Regenerate with `session_slot_bytes.py --write` in the commit that moves a number. `rustc` is information, not compared.
